nodes.label: Shared graph update procedure (post-PR, by PR author)
nodes.community_name: Team Workflow Guide (Claude Code + Graphify + Git)
nodes.norm_label: shared graph update procedure (post-pr, by pr author)
nodes.rationale: Mandatory after every PR merged to main, done the same day by the author of that PR so updates stay ordered and no two people update at once. Code changes use AST-only 'graphify update .' (no LLM, no token cost); document changes need semantic '/graphify . --update' via Claude Code.

nodes.label: Merge-not-rebase policy
nodes.community_name: Team Workflow Guide (Claude Code + Graphify + Git)
nodes.rationale: All published branches use merge, never rebase or push --force, to keep shared history safe.

nodes.label: config/env.ts (readEnv/requireEnv)
nodes.rationale: Values left as <INSERT_...> markers are treated as empty so integrations return 503 instead of sending markers to providers.

nodes.label: No-secrets policy (.env, MySQL, PayPal, Twilio, Google Maps credentials)
nodes.norm_label: no-secrets policy (.env, mysql, paypal, twilio, google maps credentials)

nodes.label: JWT_SECRET (HS256 access tokens)
nodes.rationale: Backend refuses to start if missing or under 32 bytes; tokens include issuer/audience and expire in one hour.

nodes.label: Never Prefix Secrets with VITE_
nodes.rationale: Anything with VITE_ ends up in the JavaScript downloaded by the browser.

nodes.label: Team Rules (Reglas del equipo)
nodes.rationale: Prevent graph churn and destructive git ops: graphify-out only committed on graphify branch, no pushes to main/graphify/others' branches, no force push/rebase/reset --hard, specific git add, no absolute paths in versioned files.
